scope: Pinned RNA enzyme XML and deterministic six-field native registry projection; all fourteen source records are retained in document order.

projection.order: Physical XML enzyme-node order; no sorting, normalization or dropped entries.
projection.missing_fields: Absent fields become empty strings. No main RegEx or synonym field exists in any of these fourteen XML records.
projection.runtime_use: RNaseDB::global includes the projection directly; no runtime XML parser is required.

generator.dependencies: Python standard library only: ElementTree, json, hashlib, pathlib, argparse.
generator.method: Verify pinned XML SHA-256, require fourteen records and only the six expected fields, emit escaped Rust string tuples in XML order, and compare exact output text with --check.

independent_reference.comparison: All 84 projected field slots and order independently matched both raw XML and the packaged reference TSV.

license.basis: OpenMS repository license for its enzyme data; original XML comments and descriptions are retained.
license.boundary: This metadata does not grant or infer separate rights for MODOMICS records used when resolving terminal gains.

native_scope_boundary: All fourteen registered RNA enzymes and composition of their supported per-code expressions or literal searches are implemented. Arbitrary Boost regex syntax, an XML input/provider API, and IdentificationData RNA graph digestion remain outside the native surface.
